phase: Source, meaningful CPU vector/proof checks, plain cargo check only. No device ELF, Arena, model activation or speed claim.

fixed_policy.matrix: row x and row w both use R=D H64/8 independently in each contiguous64-channel block; 15 blocks per unchanged960 group
fixed_policy.sign: SplitMix64(absolute_channel XOR0x243F6A8885A308D3), including standard SplitMix increment; high bit selects minus; identical across tokens/output rows
fixed_policy.forward: sign first; six separately rounded F32 add/sub butterfly stages strides1,2,4,8,16,32; exactnormal multiplication0.125; one nearest-even BF16 round
fixed_policy.inverse: R transpose: H64/8 first, signs last, not the same forward transform
fixed_policy.quantization: unchanged independent u128 quotient/remainder rational per960 oracle on original/rotated BF16; scale RN32(A*RN32(1/7)), never MSE/1-over-rotation-scale

inputs: Provided layer0 direct low/high F4 times per16 finiteE4 rounded BF16; no nativeE4 row dequant. Existing production loader retained. prefix_sliding_bf16 exports after raw gamma and original BF16 cut. Unchanged q020 sliding_projection_owned supplies original feedback; geglu_bf16 on its joined output supplies fixed production hidden. Gamma/norm/residual/GeGLU arithmetic is untouched.

minimal_sampling.pair: current row p maps canonical owner p or (73*p+127)%512; weight output row=(317*owner+19)%projection_rows. Both orders compare identical pairs sorted by owner. Both steps use original q020 residual feedback. UP/GATE share prefix; DOWN uses current production hidden, never an approximate chain hidden.
minimal_sampling.weight_loading: Decode only512 preregistered output rows per projection from immutable full safetensors. Rotate/quantize them once on CPU; no full shadow model or extra GPU weight owner.

arms: ideal forward F64 Hadamard dot (finite precision evaluation of exact-real identity, with explicit absolute rounding bound)
proof_and_ranges: Immutable root Fraction proof/vectors retained. dense_exact_f64 field is rounded display and NOT an exact oracle. Rust checks input/sign/rotatedF32/BF16 bits byte-exact; independent direct dense matrix tests check butterfly/inverse. Actual rows fail-stop unless inputs, F32 intermediates, exactnormal /8 and rounded BF16 are finite normal-or-zero; no unsupported FTZ/overflow claim. F64 ideal identity uses an absolute bound scaled by input norm product and channel count, independent of cancellation. Final BF16 rounding error is separately measured.
decision: For every UP/GATE/DOWN step in each order: rotation-only sampled relativeL2<=0.01 AND rotatedA4W4 sampled relativeL2<=0.75*originalA4W4. Every owner-associated per-pair output agrees across roworders. Any failed gate => HOLD, no tuning. Correctness/identity pass does not imply quality gate pass.
metrics: All dots are pre-global projections, with original global reported but not applied. No BF16 GeGLU/DOWN boundary or whole-FFN output approximation claim. F64 sum of dequantized code*storedscale products differs from device localF32 weightMul/activationMul/reduction. Report sampled error SSE/referenceSS/maxabs, zero fractions and rotation-only error separately; no additive decomposition.
integrity: Freeze all original src/config hashes. Three unchanged runtime entries plus five unchanged production startup entries expected if later built; no new device function. Independent CPU sample code tests, full source tensor fingerprints, full production retained-byte fingerprints, full immutable activation readbacks after CPU analysis, all512 row permutation of prefix/hidden/production states. No hidden references to other owners or mutation.

cost_scope.scope: PerP512FFN count only; no SDK mapping/resource/latency proof. Host-only sampled weights avoid all48 startup; no inference to full model. Extra CPU original/F64/rounded representations are diagnostic-only.

prior_failures: Preserve rational whole-row/grouped FFN, gamma-only balancing and fixedMSE HOLDs. Official q020/final unchanged.
